annotations.text: Lifted from app/globals.css and components/icons.tsx, not redrawn by eye — every hex, radius and icon path is the value the app actually ships.
The five screens. Map tiles are stylised: OpenStreetMap can't be reached from inside a canvas, so the streets are drawn in.
The feed sheet at peek (42%). It drags to 86%, committing on distance or a flick.

Two steps, because Facebook usually refuses the page: paste a link, get asked for the event text, then check the draft. The highlighted field is the one the model inferred rather than read. Anything submitted saves as 'à confirmer'.
